en.text: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你和亚伦、拿答、亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都要上到我这里来，远远地下拜。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你和亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都要上到我這裏來，遠遠地下拜。

en.text: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

zhSimplified.text: 惟独你可以亲近耶和华；他们却不可亲近；百姓也不可和你一同上来。」

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨你可以親近耶和華；他們卻不可親近；百姓也不可和你一同上來。」

en.text: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”

zhSimplified.text: 摩西下山，将耶和华的命令典章都述说与百姓听。众百姓齐声说：「耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩西下山，將耶和華的命令典章都述說與百姓聽。眾百姓齊聲說：「耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。」

en.text: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西将耶和华的命令都写上。清早起来，在山下筑一座坛，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，

zhTraditional.text: 摩西將耶和華的命令都寫上。清早起來，在山下築一座壇，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，

en.text: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 又打发以色列人中的少年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华献牛为平安祭。

zhTraditional.text: 又打發以色列人中的少年人去獻燔祭，又向耶和華獻牛為平安祭。

en.text: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西将血一半盛在盆中，一半洒在坛上；

zhTraditional.text: 摩西將血一半盛在盆中，一半灑在壇上；

en.text: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”

zhSimplified.text: 又将约书念给百姓听。他们说：「耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。」

zhTraditional.text: 又將約書念給百姓聽。他們說：「耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。」

en.text: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”

zhSimplified.text: 摩西将血洒在百姓身上，说：「你看！这是立约的血，是耶和华按这一切话与你们立约的凭据。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩西將血灑在百姓身上，說：「你看！這是立約的血，是耶和華按這一切話與你們立約的憑據。」

en.text: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西、亚伦、拿答、亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都上了山。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西、亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都上了山。

en.text: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

zhSimplified.text: 他们看见以色列的 神，他脚下仿佛有平铺的蓝宝石，如同天色明净。

zhTraditional.text: 他們看見以色列的上帝，他腳下彷彿有平鋪的藍寶石，如同天色明淨。

en.text: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

zhSimplified.text: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他们观看 神；他们又吃又喝。

zhTraditional.text: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他們觀看上帝；他們又吃又喝。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你上山到我这里来，住在这里，我要将石版并我所写的律法和诫命赐给你，使你可以教训百姓。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你上山到我這裏來，住在這裏，我要將石版並我所寫的律法和誡命賜給你，使你可以教訓百姓。」

en.text: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西和他的帮手约书亚起来，上了 神的山。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西和他的幫手約書亞起來，上了上帝的山。

en.text: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

zhSimplified.text: 摩西对长老说：「你们在这里等着，等到我们再回来，有亚伦、户珥与你们同在。凡有争讼的，都可以就近他们去。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩西對長老說：「你們在這裏等着，等到我們再回來，有亞倫、戶珥與你們同在。凡有爭訟的，都可以就近他們去。」

en.text: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西上山，有云彩把山遮盖。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西上山，有雲彩把山遮蓋。

en.text: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的荣耀停于西奈山；云彩遮盖山六天，第七天他从云中召摩西。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的榮耀停於西奈山；雲彩遮蓋山六天，第七天他從雲中召摩西。

en.text: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的荣耀在山顶上，在以色列人眼前，形状如烈火。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的榮耀在山頂上，在以色列人眼前，形狀如烈火。

en.text: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西进入云中上山，在山上四十昼夜。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西進入雲中上山，在山上四十晝夜。
